question: Will [TITLE] be nominated for Best Show in its category at the Golden Globe Awards?

SHOW_TITLE.reason: The template asks about a television show's title. The available vocabulary does not include SHOW_TITLE or TV-specific series placeholders, so TITLE is the closest canonical placeholder. FILM/MOVIE variants are less appropriate because the subcategory is Television.

resolution_date_rule: Resolution date should align with Golden Globe nomination announcement date. Resolution date should be December 1 of the calendar year.
